title: Staged region flip + marketplace telemetry handoff for AWS/Azure/GCP listings
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Coordinate staged region activations for AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, and GCP Marketplace listings. Ensure marketplace artifacts (SKU mapping, marketplace images, licensing text) are validated per-region, run localized QA, and hand off telemetry/events to Observability for post-launch monitoring and automated rollback triggers. This ticket covers orchestration runbook, cross-team checkpoints, and final release notes copy for each marketplace channel.
acceptance_criteria: All three marketplace listings published to staging regions and smoke tests pass
SKU & billing mapping validated with Finance for each cloud provider
Localization review completed for en-US, en-GB, de-DE, fr-FR, ja-JP
Observability receives marketplace-specific telemetry events and alert thresholds configured
Runbook for staged region flip and rollback is documented and rehearsed in a dry run
tasks: Confirm final marketplace artifact bundles (AMI/container tag, support docs, license file)
Produce per-marketplace release notes and marketplace-specific change log entries
Coordinate with Legal to verify marketplace terms and logos for each region
Set up SKU & pricing matrix in billing dashboard; validate invoices in sandbox
Define telemetry events and labels (marketplace_channel, region, sku, release_tag)
Create runbook with step-by-step staged flip, waiting windows, and rollback steps
notes: This is a cross-org launch: Product Management (PM), Engineering (ENG), Developer Relations (DevRel), Finance, Legal, and Observability need to sign off
Prefer a 4-stage flip: staging-only, canary (5% traffic), ramp (50%), full (100%) per region
Marketplace providers have different approval timelines: AWS ~48h, Azure ~72h, GCP ~24-48h. Start submission in that order to align approvals with our flip window
We will use a single release_tag across all providers to simplify rollout correlation in telemetry
